project.title: Leachate microbial communities from a municipal landfill in Southern Ontario, Canada - Methane capture system biofilm Metagenome
project.description: Five biofouling samples from a Southern Ontario active sanitary landfill (BF1-5) underwent 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing. Three underwent metagenomic sequencing and binning.
